A.best_shot: shots seed 2, the pour over the cave mouth
A.why: Cave mouth now shows and pours come from different edges, but the ice is still a flat box of small blocks with no silhouette and the meltwater is faint.

B.best_shot: shots seed 1, the crossing from the south
B.why: Clear, readable bridge subject and a clean crossing to fight on; floor still a checkerboard with little glow and seeds are similar slashes.

C.best_shot: shots seed 2, the well from the snow
C.why: Strongest effect and real vertical shape; seeds now vary (double, elongated wells) and the rune ring frames the shot, but the shots are cluttered.

D.best_shot: shots seed 1, the arch on the crest
D.why: Layouts differ, but the fins still read as stepped bleachers grey on grey and the spindrift is nearly invisible.

E.why: Complete new place with a good steam effect and varied vent clusters; eye-level shots are still a forest of spikes and cracks don't glow.

F.best_shot: shots seed 1, the wreck from the ice
F.why: Best single subject; ship states now vary by seed and the glow is soft and broad, though it spreads too wide and the game camera tangles.

G.best_shot: shots seed 2, down the winding way
G.why: Separate mounds and a winding road now, but no light fan from the doors, so the core idea is missing from every photo.

H.why: Strong axial nave and a fine frost shaft; seeds now turn, but ruin is uniform and two game-camera shots are blocked by a column.

notes: Round 2 improved most builders on their topology notes. F, C, E and B form the top group: each has a real subject plus either an effect or a strong silhouette. H made the biggest jump on its set piece but has a broken game-camera frame. A, G and D still lack the one visual their idea depends on (a serac silhouette, a light fan, tapered fins).
